paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, “Pharoah kiang ah va lut in. Ama a hiai ka chiamtehnate ka etsak theihna ding in alungtang, asikhate lungtang toh ka khauhsak ahi.
heading: Khaukhupte

paite: Na tapa bil leh na tapa' tapa bil a, Aigupta gam a bang thil ahia ka hih, alak ua chiamtehna ka hihte na gen theih a, TOUPA ka hi chih na theihna ding un,” achi hi.
Pharaoh kiang ah Mosi leh Aaron alut ua, akiang ah, "Hebrute TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Bang tan vei ka ma a kiniamkhiak nial lai ding na hia? Ka nna aseptheihna ding un, ka mite paisak in.'
Huchi ahih kei a, ka mite paisak na nialleh ngai in, na tuipiau ah zingchiang in khaukhup ka hon sawl ding hi.
Lei mai atuam ding ua, mite'n lei amu thei kei ding. Asuakta bang ane ding ua, gial in ahon hawisak teng, lou a pan nang a dia singpou chiteng ane ding uh.

Na innte uah adim ding ua, na sikhate innte leh Aiguptate innte leh leitung om a pan tuni tan a na pate, na pate uh pate un amuh ngei louh uh," achi uhi. Huchi in akihei a, Pharaoh a pan apawtkheta hi.

Pharaoh sikhate'n akiang ah, "Bang tan hiai mipa ei a dia thang hi ding ahia? Mite paisak mai in, TOUPA a Pathian uh nna aseptheihna ding un. Aigupta hihsiat a omta ahi, chih thei nai lou na hi hia?" achi uhi.
Pharaoh kiang ah Mosi leh Aaron ahon pi nawn ua; ama'n akiang uah, “Pai un, TOUPA na Pathian uh nna va sem un. Himahleh apai dingte kuate ahi ua?" achi hi.
Mosi in, "Ka naupangte uh toh, ka tekte uh toh, ka tapate uleh ka tanute uh, ka ganhonte uleh ka belamhonte uh toh ka pai ding uhi, TOUPA kiang a ankuangluina nei ding ka hih ziak un," achi hi.
Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "TOUPA na kiang uah om hen, na numeite uh leh na nau neute uh ka hon paisakleh, en mah un, na ma uah gilou a-om hi.
Huchi hilou e, nou pasal piching teng kuan unla, TOUPA nna va sem un. Huai lah na ut ngal ua,” achi hi. Huchi in Pharaoh a pan delhkhiak in a-om uhi.

TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aigupta gam tung ah khaukhupte ahong omna ding in na khut zankhia in. Aigupta gam a ahong paitouh ua, gam a haichi teng, gial in ahawi teng tanpha anektheihna ding un,” achi hi.
Mosi in Aigupta gam tung ah achiangkhun alik a, TOUPA'Nhuai ni nitum in leh huai zankhua in suahlam huih anungsak a; zingsang ahong hih in suahlam huih in khaukhup ahon tunta hi.

Huchi in Aigupta gam tengteng tung ah khaukhupte a-om ua, Aigupta gam tengteng ah akhawl ua: achimtakhuai mahmah uhi. Amalam uah huchibang khaukhup a-om ngei kei a, anunglam uah leng huchibang a-om kei ding hi.

Lei mai tengteng atuam ziak un, gamsung amialta hi. Gam a haichi gial in ahawite, singgahte toh ane uhi. Huchi in singte ah hiam, lou a haichite ah hiam leng thil hing a-omta kei, Aigupta gamsung teng ah.
Huaitak in Pharaoh in kintak in Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, "TOUPA na Pathian leh noute tung ah ka na khialta hi.
Huaiziak in tu in ka hon ngen ahi. Tutung kia hiai ka khelhna ngaidam inla, kei a pan hiai sihna alakmang theihna ding in, TOUPA na Pathian kiang ah ngen in," achi hi.
Huchi in Pharaoh a pan apaikheta a, TOUPA kiang ah angenta hi.
TOUPA'n suahlam huih hat mahmah akhahta a, huai in khaukhupte alamang a, Tuipi San ah ahawllutta hi. Huchi in Aigupta gam tengteng ah khaukhup khat leng a-omta kei hi.
Himahleh TOUPA'N Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, Israel suante apaisak nuam tuan kei hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aigupta gam tung a khomial, theihtheih ding khop mial sah a- omtheihna ding in, van lam ah na khut liktou in," achi hi.
heading: Mialna

paite: Mosi in van lam ah akhut aliktou a; huchi in ni thum ah khomial sung Aigupta gam m tengteng bikbek a-omta hi.
Kuamah akimutuah kei ua, a-omna ua pan kuamah ni thum sung athoukhe kei uh; himahleh Israel suante tenna ah khua avak hi.
Pharaoh in Mosi asam a, "Pai un, TOUPA nna sem un. Na bawnghonte leh na ganhonte uh kia om uhen. Na nau neute un leng hon zui uhen," achi hi.
Himahleh Mosi in, “TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang a ka kithoihtheihna ding un, kithoihnate leh halmang thillatte leng na hon piak ngeingei ding ahi.

Ka bawnghonte un leng ahon zuih ding uh ahi. Nunglam ah khechin khat lel leng nutsiat ahi kei ding; huaite a pan TOUPA ka Pathian uh nna sepna dia ka lak ding uh ahih ziak in. Huai mun ka tun masiah uh, bang in ahia TOUPA nna ka sep ding uh, ka thei kei uh," achi hi.
Himahleh TOUPA'N Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, amau apaisak nuam kei.
Huchi in Pharaoh in akiang ah, "Ka kiang a pan paimang in. Ka mel mu nawn lou ding in pilvang in, ka mel na muh nini a si ding lah na hih ngal a," achi hi.
Mosi in, "Na gen bang in, na mel ka mu nawn kei ding,” achi hi.
